description

We believe that Pi will make the world fairer. To accelerate the adoption of cryptocurrency, the CEO of the financial technology company Pi Network, Dr. Nicolas Kokkalis, has decided to host a 100,000,000 Pi Giveaway Event.

To participate, simply send a minimum of 500+ Pi up to a maximum of 100,000+ Pi to the contribution address and you will immediately receive double the amount of Pi you sent, ranging from 1,000+ Pi to 200,000+ Pi (x2), to the address from which you sent it.

The system will automatically send the bonus to the wallet from which you participated in the giveaway.

faq

What do I have to do to participate in the giveaway?

To participate, simply send a minimum of 500 Pi up to a maximum of 100,000 Pi to the designated contribution address. Upon receipt, expect a doubled amount (x2), equivalent to your contributed value, to be promptly sent back.

How long will it take me to get my bonus?

You get your x2 bonus instantly! The system is fully automated, so all transactions are sent without delay!

Who is the sponsor of this giveaway?

The main sponsor of this event is Dr. Nicolas Kokkalis, the CEO of the financial technology company Pi Network.

How many times can I participate in the giveaway?

You can only participate once. If you attempt to participate more than once, you will not be eligible to receive any rewards.

How do I get my bonus?

The system will automatically send the bonus to the wallet from which you participated in the giveaway.
